title: AstralPrimitives catalog
description: The AstralPrimitives strict generation vocabulary as an A2UI catalog.
instructions: Every component has an id and a component name from this catalog. Children are referenced by id. Images, audio and downloads take a handle the host resolves, never a URL. Actionable components name a capability handle created with the surface and carry accessible_name, spoken and compact. A value read from a tool result is bound with an @path of /events/<event id><JSON pointer>.
